stack-backend-orm-database: The backend API uses FastAPI, SQLModel is used as the ORM for SQL database interactions, and PostgreSQL is the SQL database.
deployment-secrets: Before deployment, change at least SECRET_KEY, FIRST_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD, and POSTGRES_PASSWORD, and pass them through environment variables or secrets.
generate-secret-key: Run python -c "import secrets; print(secrets.token_urlsafe(32))" to generate a secure key, then use the output as a password or secret key.
copier-create-project: Install Copier with pip install copier or pipx install copier, then run copier copy https://github.com/fastapi/full-stack-fastapi-template my-awesome-project --trust. The --trust option allows the post-creation script to run.
backend-requirements: Backend development requires Docker and uv for Python package and environment management.
backend-dependency-manager: The backend Python dependencies are managed with uv; the documented installation command is uv sync from the backend directory.
backend-code-locations: Modify SQLModel models in ./backend/app/models.py, API endpoints in ./backend/app/api/, and CRUD utilities in ./backend/app/crud.py.
backend-test-command: Run backend tests with bash ./scripts/test.sh. If the stack is already running, docker compose exec backend bash scripts/tests-start.sh can be used instead.
alembic-upgrade: Run alembic upgrade head to apply the database migrations.
start-local-stack: Run docker compose watch to start the local Docker Compose development stack.
local-api-docs-url: The local Swagger UI is available at http://localhost:8000/docs.
public-env-and-ci: For a public repository, exclude .env from Git and configure CI/CD to provide the environment variables or secrets. Update compose.yml to read those CI/CD variables instead of relying on the local .env file.
remote-server-preparation: Prepare a remote server, configure DNS records, install Docker Engine, and set up the Traefik proxy and its public network before deploying the stack.
traefik-network: The Traefik proxy expects a Docker public network named traefik-public.
release-fastapi-entrypoint: The Latest Changes feature list includes Use FastAPI entrypoint (PR #2360). The document does not assign that entry to a numbered release version.
